title: Chinese year change on Feb 4, instead of Chinese new year
body:
The Chinese year change is on Feb 4 of every year, which is “Chinese beginning of Spring”. Chinese Calendar has not only the months according to the lunar, but also the 24 seasonal points according to the solar. The Feb 4 is one of the point marked as the beginning of the Spring, which is also the start of the year. Therefore, the dragon year shall also start from Feb 4. The reason Chinese Celebrate Spring Festival instead is because the Spring festival is the also start of new moon and closed to the Start of Solar for another year.
People has misunderstanding on Chinese Calendar is a lunar calendar, in fact, Chinese Calendar has also the 24 Seasonal points which is solar calendar used for agricultural reference as the lunar marks has big variations against the seasons.

title: Handy little calendar until it isn’t
body:
For the most part this app is very useful and easy to use. Gave it 2 stars because it doesn’t save the dates or more specifically the year the way I believe it should. I use this app for entering the dates of appointments, meetings, events etc when I find out the date and the app works perfectly. However, I also use it to remind me of an important event (positive or negative) that has happened. Example my Mom died a few years ago, I entered the date of her death and before saving the entry set the titled date to repeat yearly. Again it does this perfectly. But one day, my daughter asked me what year Grandma died and I couldn’t remember instantly, so I opened up this app to find out. Quickly and easily found the saved entry but realized that the year I initially entered and saved was now showing the current year. Had never known this happened before. Very disappointing as I had saved the dates of when babies were born, weddings, monumental events and accomplishments etc. This way I would know how old a friend’s child was or what anniversary a friend was celebrating etc the very reason I had saved these dates does not work properly. 
*Note* this app should be updated to include the use of camera and or add pics from your phone. Not solely from your saved folders. IMO

Creating events, appointments, things to do by certain times, planting seasons, legal document expiry dates going 3 yrs from now, etc. 
Create an event, include travel time, which then becomes a notification, add certain details, and then reminder notifications from 5 min- 2 weeks pre appointment date. Once in a while, they update the app and it gets even better.
Thank you

title: Good but it can be great!
body: There is no doubt iCal is user-friendly and works smoothly across apple devices with iCloud sync. To improve functionality, iCal lacks support for shift work that comes in handy to lots of people in different industries especially health care. It would be great to be able to add shift templates and apply them over period of time. Furthermore, showing the idea of bubbles in the zoomed out view is great idea. But it would be more functional if these bubbles can be colour-coded and corresponds with the calendar types we set up in iCal. Until, these improvements happen, I cannot fully rely on iCal when all of my appointments/events show up as one grey bubble where in fact I have multiple events per day and need to click on each day to see them. Imagine how nice to see 3 bubbles of different colours on a Monday letting you know u have work, an appointment, and maybe a hangout without going inside the day to read the details. I hope Apple is checking these out and consider this in future updates.

title: Add entries to multiple calendars.
body:
Simply explained, I have multiple calendars for work (not shared) and personal life (shared with my spouse). Much of my work is confidential and can’t be shared, but I often need to communicate times that I’m booked so my spouse knows when I’m busy, when I’ll be home, etc. Currently, there’s no way (that I’m aware of) that allows me to create a calendar entry and add it to multiple calendars at once. I have to enter the event in my work calendar for my team to see and enter the event again but in my shared family calendar for my spouse to see. 

It would be GREAT when entering a new event in the calendar app, if there was a drop down menu to select all calendars that apply to the entry. So, when I hit create, it’ll show up in the corresponding calendars I chose.
